THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Protein Gulab Jamun

Air-fried protein gulab jamuns made with blended cottage cheese, milk powder, and vanilla protein, soaked in an aromatic allulose rose-cardamom syrup. Approximately 77 calories and 8g protein per ball.

YIELD9 servings
TOTAL TIME25 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~77 cal | ~8g protein

Ingredients

DOUGH

  • 150g MULU 2% cottage cheese (not drained)
  • 2 tbsp (about 30ml) Fairlife fat-free milk (to help blend)
  • 40g nonfat milk powder
  • 40g maida / all-purpose flour
  • 32g PEScience Select Gourmet Vanilla protein powder
  • 5g melted ghee (plus 5g more for brushing)
  • 1/4 tsp baking powder

SYRUP

  • 100g pure allulose
  • 240ml water
  • 1/4 tsp ground cardamom
  • 1 tsp food-grade rosewater

Allergens: dairy, gluten.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND DAIRY. Blend the cottage cheese and milk completely smooth without draining the cottage cheese.
  2. 2.MIX & SHAPE. Combine milk powder, flour, protein powder and baking powder. Mix in blended cottage cheese and 5g melted ghee. Divide into 9 balls and brush with remaining 5g ghee.
  3. 3.AIR-FRY. Air-fry at 325°F for 10 minutes until golden brown and cooked through in the center.
  4. 4.MAKE SYRUP. Warm allulose, water and ground cardamom until allulose completely dissolves. Remove from heat and stir in food-grade rosewater.
  5. 5.SOAK & SERVE. Place cooked balls into a heat-safe bowl, pour warm syrup over them, and allow to soak before serving.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store soaked gulab jamuns in an airtight container in the refrigerator submerged in syrup.

Reheat: Microwave gently for 10-15 seconds to enjoy warm.

Lasts: Up to 4-5 days refrigerated.

Estimated nutrition

~77 cal | ~8g protein per 1 gulab jamun with syrup (1 of 9 balls).
